title: eryngium tricuspidatum var. bocconei
intro: Eryngium tricuspidatum var. bocconei, commonly known as sea holly, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae, characterized by its globe-shaped inflorescences and thistle-like flowers. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium tricuspidatum var. bocconei include its ability to reduce inflammation, stimulate digestion, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
